profile.summary: The Department of Pediatrics is part of the UC San Diego School of Medicine, a public university in the University of California system. It provides pediatric healthcare, conducts research on childhood diseases, and trains pediatricians and other specialists. It is the primary pediatric provider for Rady Children's Hospital-San Diego and UC San Diego Health.
